profile.account.signInNote: Your sign-in name comes from Discord. Sign out and theme live in the menu at the top-right.
profile.ageAndExtras.title: Age and profile extras
profile.chooseName.body: We couldn't use your Discord name, so you are {name} for now. Choose a name of your own below before you register for an event.
profile.chooseName.title: Choose your player name
profile.claim.merges: Profiles you asked to merge into yours
profile.dataExport.body: A copy of everything Dizzy holds about you, as one JSON file: your account, sessions, registrations, orders and notifications; the results, ratings and badges of the player you claimed; and what others wrote on public pages that names that player. Other players appear only as the public site shows them.
profile.dataExport.failed: Your data couldn't be prepared. Try again in a moment.
profile.dataExport.title: Your data
profile.deleteAccount.communities: Your account owns {n, plural, one {a community} other {these communities}}: {names}. Site staff must hand {n, plural, one {it} other {each one}} to another owner before you can delete your account.
profile.deleteAccount.confirm: This can't be undone. Your sign-in, sessions, notifications, API keys and settings go now.
profile.deleteAccount.confirm.title: Delete your account?
profile.deleteAccount.confirm.withPlayer: This can't be undone. Your sign-in, sessions, notifications, API keys and settings go now. Your player profile, {name}, stays with its results, but is no longer linked to you.
profile.deleteAccount.confirm.withUnplay: This can't be undone. Your sign-in, sessions, notifications, API keys and settings go now, and so does your player profile, {name}, because it has no results yet.
profile.deleteAccount.copyFirst: Want a copy first? <link>Download your data</link> before you go.
profile.deleteAccount.effect: Signs you out everywhere and removes your sign-in, sessions, notifications, API keys and settings. This can't be undone.
profile.deleteAccount.paidTime: Your Premium is paid until {date}. We refund the part you haven't had to the card you paid with, within 14 days.
profile.deleteAccount.payments: Payments for {names} go through your Stripe account, which goes with your Dizzy account. Checkout on them stops until another host connects theirs.
profile.deleteAccount.series: You run {names}. Each is left with nobody running it until its community appoints someone.
profile.deleteAccount.siteOwner: This is the site owner's account, so it can't be deleted.
profile.deleteAccount.title: Delete account
profile.display.intro: Dates and times follow this device's timezone unless you set one here.
profile.extras.hide.hint: On, your profile shows only your name, prefix and results.
profile.extras.hide.label: Hide my picture, country, flag, pronouns and characters
profile.host.empty: You don't run any events yet. Events you organise will appear here.
profile.host.registration.always.title: Registration is open with no opening or closing date set.
profile.host.registration.later.title: Registration hasn't opened yet. Nobody can sign up.
profile.identity.country.help: Where you're from, used to filter the leaderboard by region.
profile.identity.handle.random: Saving with no handle gives you a random one.
profile.identity.name: Name
profile.identity.name.help: Shown on your profile and in every bracket you enter.
profile.identity.prefix.help: A sponsor or team tag, shown before your name.
profile.identity.pronouns.help: Shown beside your name on your profile.
profile.integrations.blaze.help: Link it from the game with Link Account.
profile.integrations.discord.help: The account you sign in with.
profile.masthead.pending: Your claim on <link>{name}</link> is under review.
profile.masthead.unclaimed: You haven't claimed a player yet. Link your competitive record to your account.
profile.notifications.intro: These control push notifications. Everything still shows in your notifications.
profile.orders.title: Orders
profile.payments.connect.help: You finish setting up on Stripe, then come back here.
profile.payments.connectFailed: Connecting the Stripe account didn't finish. Try again.
profile.payments.intro: Attendees pay straight into your Stripe account. Fees, refunds and payouts are in your Stripe dashboard.
profile.payments.status.incomplete: Onboarding incomplete. Finish setup in Stripe
profile.payments.unconfigured: Payment processing isn't configured on this deployment, so new accounts can't be connected.
profile.player.noGames: Your characters show up here once you have played an event. Your handle, prefix, pronouns, country and flag live under <link>Public profile</link>.
profile.player.unclaimed: You haven't claimed a player yet. Find your player on its profile page and claim it to manage your characters here, and your handle, prefix, pronouns, country and flag under Public profile.
profile.premium.atCap: You already hold as much Premium as you can buy ahead, which is two years. You can buy more as it runs down.
profile.premium.avatar.help: A picture of your own, still or animated, in place of your Discord picture.
profile.premium.claimFirst: Every perk expresses through a claimed player. <link>Find yours</link> first.
profile.premium.comped: Complimentary, granted by the site. There is nothing to pay and nothing to manage.
profile.premium.cosmetic: Premium is cosmetic. It changes how your player looks and reads, and touches nothing competitive: not seeding, not the ratings, not who gets a place at an event.
profile.premium.handle.help: The address your player profile lives at.
profile.premium.lapse: Nothing here is taken back when Premium ends. Your handle freezes exactly as it is, and your picture sleeps until you buy more time. Until then your profile shows your Discord picture.
profile.premium.terms.adds: Buying while you have Premium adds the time to the end, up to two years ahead.
profile.premium.terms.oneOff: Each is a single payment. Premium doesn't renew and nothing is charged again, so there is nothing to cancel.
profile.premium.terms.reminder: You'll get a notification a week before it ends, and another when it has.
profile.premium.terms.startNow: Premium starts as soon as you pay. You still have 14 days to change your mind: tell us and we refund everything you paid, to the card you paid with.
profile.public.unclaimed: Your public profile is your player. Find your player on its profile page and claim it to set your handle, prefix, pronouns, country, flag and avatar here.
profile.sameName.body: Hosts added these players under the same name as yours. If one of them is you, open it and ask to merge it into your profile.
profile.sameName.title: Is this you?
profile.title: Your account
profile.under18.born: Which month were you born in?
profile.under18.bornChange: To change it, pick the month you were born in.
profile.under18.closed: Dizzy accounts are for people aged 13 and over, so we have closed your account and signed you out. We did not keep your answer. You can still look at everything on Dizzy without an account.
profile.under18.extras.hint: While you count as under 18, your profile shows only your name, prefix and results. Turn this on to show the rest to everyone.
profile.under18.extras.label: Show my picture, country, flag, pronouns and characters
profile.under18.question: Are you under 18?
profile.under18.reason: We ask so we can look after younger players, for example by leaving your name off public lists of who is coming to an event. Your answer is never shown in public. Only our moderators and the hosts of events you go to can see it.
profile.under18.status.adult: That makes you 18 or over, so we kept nothing.
profile.under18.status.flagged: A host or a moderator marked you as under 18. Only a moderator can change that.
profile.under18.title: Under 18
profile.under18.under13: Dizzy accounts are for people aged 13 and over. If this is right, saving closes your account. You can still look at everything on Dizzy without an account.
profile.under18.why: We only keep the month you turn 18. We never keep your birthday.
